summary: Search field (type="search") with icon, clear button, Enter to submit, and loading indicator. Searching, debouncing, and requests are up to the consumer.
whenToUse: Local filtering of lists and tables.
Global search that leads to a results page.
whenNotToUse: Picking a value from suggestions: use Combobox.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called by the button or Escape.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Shows a Spinner with a “Loading…” announcement.

props.name: label / aria-label
props.description: Visible or accessible label (one of the two is required).

accessibility: Native role="searchbox"; labelled “Clear” button, hidden when empty.
Announce the number of results with an aria-live region in the consumer.
responsive: Takes the width of the container.
customization: WebKit’s native clear button is hidden to avoid duplicates.
commonMistakes: Firing a request on every keystroke without debouncing.
Not announcing the number of results.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled value and onClear
examples.description: The value lives in the example’s state: the buttons change it externally and onClear counts the clears.
